newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse names Farid Suleman as CFO of CBS.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse names Farid Suleman as CFO of CBS.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp. said on Friday it appointed Farid Suleman as the senior vice president and chief financial officer of its new CBS Station Group.
Suleman, who has served as the chief financial officer of the CBS Radio Group since January 1997, was the chief financial officer of Infinity Broadcasting before it merged with CBS last year.
"Farid is an extremely gifted financial executive who brings a strong results orientation to our CBS television stations," said Fredric Reynolds, chief financial officer of Westinghouse.
Westinghouse said in May that all of its television and radio stations would be consolidated into a single unit as part of a corporate reorganization.
The consolidation precedes a plan to split the industrial businesses of Westinghouse from its media businesses, which will become CBS Corp.
At present, CBS Radio owns 77 stations in 16 markets.
